title: OTHRYS OS Alpha persistent Work surface
goal: Expose a Panda-style OTHRYS OS Alpha shell on the tablet, backed by canonical V2 mission/evidence state rather than chat-only progress.
laws: Reuse the existing Command Deck; do not create a parallel control plane.
Canonical repo mission/state evidence outranks conversational summaries.
Progress must distinguish Plan, Build, Review, and Ship without fake completion.
Legion remains builder; T590 remains independent verifier and tablet-facing host.
Human approval and independent evidence remain separate concepts.
No new Accept, Reject, release, shell, Hephaestus, Talos, or Worker execution authority.
PandaOS visual/workflow patterns may be reconstructed, but Panda branding/assets/code are forbidden.
